name.ja: メカコレクション 99式空間戦闘攻撃機 コスモファルコン（空母搭載機）
name.en: Mecha Collection Type 99 space combat attack aircraft Cosmo Falcon (aircraft carrier-based aircraft)

description.ja: メカコレクションに『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202』に登場の「99式空間戦闘攻撃機 コスモファルコン（空母搭載機）」が登場！
description.en: The "Type 99 space combat attack aircraft Cosmo Falcon (carrier-based aircraft)" that appeared in " Space Battleship Yamato 2202" is now available in the mecha collection!

description.ja: • アンドロメダ級三番艦アポロノームに配備されているコスモファルコンを手のひらサイズながら精密に再現！
description.en: • The Cosmo Falcon deployed on the third Andromeda class ship Apollo Nome is accurately reproduced in a palm-sized size!

description.ja: • アポロノーム仕様のマーキングシールが付属し、特徴的なロゴも再現可能！
description.en: • Apolnome-specific MarkingSeal is included, allowing you to reproduce the distinctive logo!

description.ja: • ポールジョイントで角度調整が可能な台座が付属。飛行シーンの再現も可能。
description.en: • A pedestal whose angle can be adjusted with a pole joint is included. It is also possible to reproduce flight scenes.

accessories.ja: 専用ディスプレイベース×1

contents.ja: 取扱説明書（箱裏側に記載）
contents.en: Instruction manual (written on the back of the box)
